description: GNN topology validation sweep for TSMC Process dataset (11D node features: 7 base + 4 process params)

_comments.voltage_mode_options: all_nodes (voltage on all nodes), vdd_only (voltage only on VDD), vdd_mos (voltage on VDD and MOS nodes)
_comments.normalization_options: zscore (z-score normalization, default), minmax (min-max to [epsilon, 1] range)
_comments.temp_mode_options: typical (temp on MOS only, default), temp_all (temp on all nodes)
_comments.output_node_idx_note: output_node_idx is dynamically determined from topology cache
_comments.adaptation_method_options: selective_adam (grad/move + conditional Adam), adam (direct Adam, no grad/move)
_comments.cache_path_note: cache_path points to TOPOLOGY CACHE file (for adjacency). gatectrl/bidir/directmos are auto-detected from filename for checkpoint dir.
_comments.inputport_note: Set 'inputport': true if using inputport topology. checkpoint_suffix = cache_suffix(gatectrl) + topology_suffix(inputport)
_comments.related_pin_only_note: Set 'related_pin_only': true if using related_pin_only slew assignment. Adds _relpin suffix to paths.
